TABLE.NAME: repository_largefile_chunks
TABLE.COMMENT: Tracks chunked uploads of large files. id, userid, contextid, maxlength and state are set when the token is created; the remaining fields are filled as chunks arrive.

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Upload token generated when the picker screen renders.

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Context the upload was started in.

FIELD.NAME: maxlength
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum allowed bytes, or -1 for unlimited.

FIELD.NAME: lastmodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Time the row was last touched, for cleanup.

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: 0: token generated, not used; 1: upload started; 2: upload completed.

FIELD.NAME: length
FIELD.COMMENT: Total expected file length in bytes.
